Sandbox_SHP_RequiredFirstAidLevel_toolti:
First Aid level needed to see how far a wound has healed in the Health tab.
0: anyone can see it.
1-10: the level needed. When treating another player, the level of the one treating counts.
Wounds are still tracked below that level, so the numbers are right as soon as it is reached.
Sandbox_SHP_TextColor_tooltip:
Color of the healing progress lines in the Health tab.
Click the color to pick another one. The default is light blue.
